exportFormat.verificationLimit: The initial supplied sample stops before the field documentation. The complete official page verifies the six-column order, but this review did not inspect actual detailed corpus records.

attributionHandling.plannedAuthorIdentifier: Username from the detailed export, documented as the sentence owner name; preserve it as the contributor attribution identifier alongside sentence ID and source URL.
attributionHandling.recommendedPublicationRecord: Keep a contributor attribution index and per-sentence provenance alongside any redistributed corpus or derived corpus.
attributionHandling.unknownAuthorHandling: Do not silently invent author names; let the root ingestion record its exclusion or attribution-resolution policy.
attributionHandling.ownerNameLimit: The export documents owner name. These sources do not certify that the current exported owner is always the original author. An author-family split should be described precisely as a split by exported username/owner.

limits.finding: The community platform does not certify the skills of every contributor. These sources do not establish that every exported sentence was written by a human without automation.
limits.quote: whose skills we do not check whatsoever.

limits.finding: Sentence claims are not certified as factual or logically valid.
limits.quote: We judge neither the logic nor the veracity of statements.

limits.finding: Professional translation accuracy is not guaranteed.
limits.quote: the validity and accuracy of translations are not guaranteed by any professional intervention.

limits.finding: The platform does not guarantee complete license-compliance checking of all contributions.
limits.quote: Tatoeba will not always have the means to put in place technical measures to ensure the complete compliance of licenses.

limits.finding: Only the supplied English terms were reviewed; the site identifies French as the controlling version if translations differ.
limits.quote: In case of any differences in meaning between the translations of these Terms of Use, the French version prevails, in its most recent update.

conclusion: Official Tatoeba documentation supports CC BY 2.0 FR as the default license for textual sentences and requires author attribution. Detailed Sentences has six tab-separated columns: Sentence id, Lang, Text, Username, Date added, Date last modified. The separate CC0 export has four columns and no Username field. The detailed export describes Username as owner name; preserve it with sentence-level provenance without claiming certification of original authorship, universal human authorship or factual correctness.
